# GitHub repository metadata

These are the prepared public-facing repository fields. GitHub provides one About description field, so the proposed value combines English and Chinese; the full introductions are separate in [README.md](../README.md) and [README.en.md](../README.en.md).

## About description

Windows archive merging workspace: organize multiple archives, preview assets, and export one ZIP or 7z delivery. | Windows 多压缩包合并工作台：整理多个压缩包、预览素材，统一导出 ZIP / 7z 交付包。

## English short introduction

Multiple archives. One delivery workspace. Organize, preview, and merge archives into a single ZIP or 7z deliverable on Windows.

## Chinese short introduction

多压缩包，一个交付工作台。在 Windows 上整理、预览和合并多个压缩包，统一导出 ZIP 或 7z 交付包。

## Topics

`archive-manager`, `archive-merger`, `windows`, `desktop-app`, `python`, `pyside6`, `qt-widgets`, `zip`, `7zip`, `file-management`, `audio-preview`, `game-audio`

## Publication status

The source and bilingual introductions are prepared for publication. The About description and topics have not been applied: the connected GitHub tools do not expose repository metadata updates, and Windows browser automation stopped because it could not verify the current browser URL. These fields require an authenticated GitHub repository settings action.
